title: The Last Shift
designPurpose: A quiet psychological reader identity built around emotional distance, gradual transition, and small displaced marks that feel like thoughts moving out of alignment.

sourceAsset.format: JPEG original preserved as PNG reference

websiteAsset.optimization: Converted from the official JPEG at WebP quality 88; preserves cover typography while reducing file size.

printAsset.printReadiness: Best available full-resolution reference, not genuine 300 DPI production print art for a 5.5in x 8.5in trim.

targetDpi.availableEffectiveDpiAtReferenceTrim: approximately 186 DPI by width and 181 DPI by height, below 300 DPI target

coverSpecification.titlePlacement: Large centered title block in the lower-middle area, below the Greyveil mark.
coverSpecification.subtitlePlacement: Centered below the series/book line, under the title divider.
coverSpecification.authorPlacement: Centered near the lower cover, above the publisher and year.
coverSpecification.publisherMarkPlacement: Greyveil Editions logo and wordmark are centered in the upper third; publisher name repeats near the lower edge.
coverSpecification.safeMargin: Existing artwork keeps key typography within the internal border; preserve at least 7% visual margin on all sides when fitting into fixed pages.
coverSpecification.bleedGuidance: No full paperback bleed file exists yet. Do not crop this asset for bleed without a higher-resolution cover master.
coverSpecification.colourProfileGuidance: Current source is an RGB web JPEG. Future print production should request a high-resolution RGB or CMYK master from the designer/printer.
coverSpecification.imageFitBehavior: Use object-fit: contain for the digital reader. Preserve the complete artwork, aspect ratio, and typography. Do not recolor, filter, stretch, or crop.

WordCoverPageMapping.insertionGuidance: Insert the PNG as a full first page using fit-to-page containment. Disable Word image compression where possible.
WordCoverPageMapping.printLimitation: Current PNG is below 300 DPI for the reference trim and should be replaced before final print production.

PdfCoverPageMapping.fitMode: Contain within the trim box unless a higher-resolution bleed-ready cover is supplied.
PdfCoverPageMapping.printLimitation: Current asset is suitable as a digital/PDF reference but is not a final 300 DPI print cover.

paperbackWrapStatus.status: Front cover only. Full wrap cover, spine, and back cover are not included yet.
paperbackWrapStatus.spineGuidance: Spine width depends on final page count, paper stock, binding method, and printer specification.

typography.letterSpacing: 0 for all display headings; 0.12em only for small uppercase metadata

tablet.bodyMeasure: centered literary page with balanced outer margins

mobile.overflowRule: no horizontal overflow; title and chapter headings constrained by max-width and reduced motif scale

titlePage.composition: left-set title block centered vertically with a slight upward optical shift
titlePage.coverTreatment: cover image hidden inside the reader title page
titlePage.motif: two displaced horizontal rules, 96px and 58px, offset 14px horizontally and 12px vertically

dedicationOrEpigraph.composition: centered, quiet, with generous vertical breathing room
dedicationOrEpigraph.motif: paired short rules above the dedication, centered but intentionally offset

contentsPage.treatment: unboxed editorial lines; source leaders preserved; active drawer item uses a slim indigo left rule

chapterOpeningPage.motif: 72px and 42px rules displaced by 12px; motif becomes 54px and 32px on mobile

normalContinuationPage.bodyFlow: quiet continuous prose with small first-line indent and no decorative interruptions except manuscript section breaks
normalContinuationPage.topBottomFrame: faint internal horizontal rules inherited from page surface

pageNumbers.rule: 24px x 1px centered above the numeral at 34% accent opacity

finalManuscriptPage.appliesTo: ending, epilogue, teaser, and about-author pages
finalManuscriptPage.treatment: subtle bottom indigo wash and slightly quieter text to signal closing distance without changing content

feedbackSurface.surface: same warm ivory paper as final matter
feedbackSurface.mobileBehavior: natural-height expanded feedback page with no nested panel scrolling
feedbackSurface.payloadRule: feedback endpoint and fields are controlled by shared reader.js and book.json, not the theme

mobile390InspectionTarget.pageWidth: CSS target calc(100vw - 20px), rendered inside an 8px stage gutter
mobile390InspectionTarget.toolbar: compact shared toolbar retained; controls inherit tighter theme sizing
mobile390InspectionTarget.feedback: expanded panel remains natural height and one-column

tablet768InspectionTarget.chapterHierarchy: left-set chapter header with full displaced motif

desktop1366InspectionTarget.spacing: 58px between pages with subtle edge and shadow

futureWordPdfMapping.sectionBreak: two rules: 0.44in and 0.27in, displaced by 0.12in horizontally and 0.07in vertically
futureWordPdfMapping.pageNumber: Inter 8pt or Arial 8pt, centered 0.30in from trim bottom with 0.24in rule above
futureWordPdfMapping.specialPages: opening, contents, dedication, and feedback equivalents carry no folio

generationContract.sourceOfTruth: The website reader design remains authoritative; generated formats must map from this specification and existing reader theme tokens.

normalizedContentBlocks.unknownTypeHandling: Warn during validation and preserve the raw block for later exporter decisions.

printReference.minimumFinalPrintRequirement: Replace with a true 300 DPI cover master before production print output.

sourceReference.purpose: Preserved visual reference for future cover regeneration or print preparation.
